title: Selling the News is Getting Old
summary: I can’t wait for this evening. I actually enjoy watching election results roll in, and I look forward to the biennial ritual of flipping channels to watch data nerds stand in front of maps of congressional districts to breathlessly share granular polling data. But I also look forward to tomorrow, when my inbox stops groaning from campaign solicitations and televised sports events run ads for beer, not candidates. In the meantime, we will discuss an important post-earnings trading pattern.
